Class RMLTime

java.lang.Object
com.reactiveplayz.rml.RMLType
com.reactiveplayz.rml.RMLTime
public final class RMLTime extends RMLType
A RMLType subclass to represent time

It represents an immutable LocalTime and returns it upon calling raw()

It also stores an immutable offset (ZoneOffset) that defaults to UTC
